title: I Can’t Pay Off My Holy Sword Loan!
description: When the Demon Lord returns, adventurer Thiol comes to the royal capital hoping to be chosen by the Holy Sword. He succeeds... but the goddess Icon immediately saddles him with debt. The sword is useless unless he pays for upgrades, and its abilities unlock only as his repayment balance grows. Thiol sets out with Icon and his companions to repay the loan while aiming to defeat the Demon Lord: will he earn glory, or go bankrupt first?
author: Masakichi
